definitions.gloss: Izumo; the old province in eastern Shimane Prefecture
definitions.explanation: The historical province covering the eastern half of present-day Shimane Prefecture, on the Sea of Japan coast. In Japanese cultural reference it stands above all for {出雲大社|いずもたいしゃ}, the grand shrine associated with {縁結|えんむす}び — the tying of romantic and other bonds — and for the myths collected in the {古事記|こじき}.

examples.japanese: {出雲大社|いずもたいしゃ}にお{参|まい}りした。
{縁結|えんむす}びを{願|ねが}って{出雲|いずも}まで{足|あし}を{運|はこ}ぶ{人|ひと}は{多|おお}い。
examples.english: Many people make the trip all the way to Izumo to pray for a good match.

examples.japanese: {出雲|いずも}では{十月|じゅうがつ}を{神無月|かんなづき}ではなく{神在月|かみありづき}と{呼|よ}ぶ。
examples.english: In Izumo they call the tenth month kamiarizuki, 'the month with gods', rather than kannazuki.

examples.japanese: {出雲|いずも}{地方|ちほう}には{古事記|こじき}に{登場|とうじょう}する{神話|しんわ}の{舞台|ぶたい}が{数多|かずおお}く{残|のこ}っている。
examples.english: The Izumo region retains many of the settings of the myths that appear in the Kojiki.

notes:
CULTURAL NOTE:
Izumo is the country's best-known destination for {縁結|えんむす}び, so mentioning it in conversation often carries an implication about relationships. It is also the one place that inverts the name of the tenth lunar month: elsewhere it is {神無月|かんなづき}, the month without gods, because the gods are believed to have gathered in Izumo — where the same month is therefore {神在月|かみありづき}, the month with gods.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {出雲大社|いずもたいしゃ}: Izumo Grand Shrine
- {出雲|いずも}そば: Izumo soba, a regional buckwheat noodle style
- {出雲|いずも}{神話|しんわ}: the Izumo myth cycle
- {出雲|いずも}{地方|ちほう}: the Izumo region

Note the reading: {出|いず} + {雲|も}, an old place-name reading that follows neither the on'yomi nor the ordinary kun'yomi of the two characters.
